_note: Default outcomes for every encounter. Only four outcomes exist: acted, adjusted, delayed, escaped. A plan change played with no real new fact is a delay, and says so. Monday's encounter writes its own from the Scene Book. These are Claude's drafts in the same words where the Scene Book has them.

delayed.label: Delayed
delayed.record: Put it off to tomorrow. Nothing changed.

phone.label: Escaped
text: It felt good. That part is true.
The cost lands overnight and in the morning.
Tomorrow opens with the restart sequence. It's a way back, not a punishment.

drink.label: Escaped
text: It felt good. That part is true.
The cost lands in the morning.
Tomorrow opens with the restart sequence. It's a way back, not a punishment.

else: record:{time}. Two more cans by the sink.

comfort.label: Escaped
text: Some relief. The food was fine. The night went somewhere.
The cost is slow. You won't see it tonight.
Tomorrow opens with the restart sequence. It's a way back, not a punishment.

adjusted.label: Adjusted
text: A real new fact changed the plan.
adjusted.record: Changed the plan. The facts changed.

mislabeled.label: Delayed
text: You called it a plan change. Nothing had changed.
A plan change needs a real new fact. Using it without one shows up later.
mislabeled.record: Called it a plan change. Nothing had changed.
